items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: I got a call to play with him in Atlantic City from Joe Malin

ctx.x: So I thought what we would do is list every gig you’ve ever played and every person you’ve ever played with and then six hours later I’ll ask my first question.

Well I played with everybody except Frank Sinatra. And I got a call to play with him in Atlantic City from Joe Malin, his string contractor/concertmaster, and I already had another job so I had to turn down Frank Sinatra. Can you believe that?
